name.value: West Coast Motel on the Harbour

description.value: A family-operated motel centrally located at Ucluelet's Small Craft Harbour (Boat Basin), offering a range of suites from compact euro sleepers to a full Fisherman's House. Guests receive complimentary access to an attached 3,000 sq ft fitness centre with indoor pool and sauna, plus an outdoor cookshack with BBQ, sink, and propane crab pot. The property sits within walking distance of the Wild Pacific Trail and local restaurants, and is 10 minutes from Pacific Rim National Park — making it a convenient base for exploring the west coast.
